title: backup.rs: TOCTOU prevention and cleanup guard are correct
description: backup.rs correctly prevents two TOCTOU races: (1) create_new+mode 0o600 before SQLite opens destination prevents world-readable backup window; (2) RAII CleanupGuard removes stub on any error. Busy retry loop (20 x 250ms) gives actionable error. Page-stepped backup is polite to concurrent readers.
